india.one_line: Karnataka's AI workforce mapped, Sarvam's Chinese-model platform sparks sovereignty debate, and Disseqt raises for AI governance.

themes.title: Karnataka's AI workforce mapped
themes.text: A Zinnov-KDEM report released at the Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026 found Karnataka hosts 1,088 global capability centres (51% of India's total) and 111,000 AI/ML professionals, with over 120 dedicated AI/ML Centres of Excellence.

stories.headline: Karnataka hosts 1,088 GCCs and 111,000 AI/ML professionals, new report finds

themes.title: Sarvam's platform sparks sovereignty debate
themes.text: Sarvam AI launched its Token Factory inference platform on November 16, offering eight open-weight models via an OpenAI-compatible API on Indian GPU clusters, six of which are from Chinese firms. The company received a ₹98.68 crore government GPU subsidy for building indigenous models.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI’s Token Factory hosts mostly Chinese models on Indian GPUs, sparking sovereign AI debate

themes.title: Disseqt raises for AI governance
themes.text: Disseqt AI, an Irish-headquartered startup providing testing and compliance tools for AI agents, secured $8 million led by Gresham House Ventures to grow its enterprise customer base, open London operations, and increase hiring in India.

stories.headline: Disseqt AI raises $8 million to expand enterprise AI governance platform
